artifacts.summary: Answers O1-O4 for the L-plus compression theorem: Liftable is decidable by bi-infinite subset construction (not by simulation, which is incomplete); the general liftable trans is reached via transId plus liftable_of_spliceClosed rather than a new pigeonhole; the (C5) lasso-count bound is singly exponential in |closure|, superseding both |closure|+1 and |closure| x window; and no GKWZ product-undecidability result bounds the two nested S5-like modalities. Also records that no sharing-side compression theorem exists on either side, so the task is a new subtree rather than a transcription, and names the theorem-index and C2 AXIOM_BASELINE gate edits.
